features.name: Patient Registration
features.description: Patients can create and manage their account profiles with personal and medical information.
user_stories: As a patient, I can register an account so that I can book appointments with doctors.
As a patient, I can update my profile information so that my medical records are current.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new patient, When they complete the registration form, Then an account is created and confirmation email is sent.
Given a registered patient, When they update their profile, Then the changes are saved and reflected immediately.

features.name: Appointment Scheduling
features.description: Patients can search for available doctors and book appointments based on specialty and availability.
user_stories: As a patient, I can view available appointment slots so that I can choose a convenient time.
As a patient, I can book an appointment with a specific doctor so that I can receive medical care.
acceptance_criteria: Given available doctors, When a patient searches by specialty, Then a list of matching doctors with time slots is displayed.
Given an available time slot, When a patient confirms booking, Then the appointment is reserved and confirmation is sent.

features.name: Appointment Management
features.description: Patients and doctors can view, reschedule, or cancel existing appointments.
user_stories: As a patient, I can cancel my appointment so that I can free up the time slot if I cannot attend.
As a doctor, I can view my appointment schedule so that I can prepare for patient visits.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booked appointment, When a patient cancels it, Then the slot becomes available and notification is sent.
Given a doctor login, When they access their dashboard, Then all scheduled appointments are displayed chronologically.

features.name: Doctor Profile Management
features.description: Doctors can manage their profiles including specialties, availability, and consultation fees.
user_stories: As a doctor, I can set my available hours so that patients can book during my working times.
As a doctor, I can update my specialty information so that patients can find me for specific treatments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a doctor account, When they set availability hours, Then only those time slots are shown to patients.
Given a doctor profile, When specialty is updated, Then the search results reflect the new information immediately.

features.name: Notification System
features.description: Automated notifications for appointment confirmations, reminders, and cancellations via email and SMS.
user_stories: As a patient, I can receive appointment reminders so that I do not miss my scheduled visit.
As a doctor, I can receive notifications of new bookings so that I am aware of my schedule changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a confirmed appointment, When it is 24 hours before the time, Then a reminder is sent to the patient.
Given a new booking, When a patient schedules an appointment, Then the doctor receives an immediate notification.
